patch_description:
Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic population-based maximin search in barycentric coordinates. Three triangle vertices are retained as fixed points, while eight interior/boundary points are evolved by differential mutations and targeted Gaussian mutations.

The objective is evaluated simultaneously for every population member and all 165 triples. Since the minimum area is controlled by only a few active constraints, the targeted stage identifies points occurring in the currently smallest triangles and perturbs precisely those coordinates. This is substantially more effective than uniform late-stage noise. Barycentric projection guarantees that every returned point remains in the required equilateral triangle, and exact elitism retains the best arrangement throughout the fixed-seed search.
